text:
[LTIM.2.8.6] **The entry stamp.** The engine **must** stamp each fact, when
it enters working memory, with the monotonic clock's current sample: the fact's
**entry stamp**. A fact replaced by retract-and-replace ([LFAC.1.2.2]) enters
anew and takes a new stamp; a suppressed no-op reassertion ([LFAC.2.5.1]) does
not enter and keeps its stamp. `dwell` ([LEXP.9.5.1]) and `within`
([LTIM.2.7.1]) measure from the entry stamp. It is engine state, not a slot: no
slot a schema declares, `ts` included, is read by either.

---

idris.name: Ltim_2_8_6__stamps
idris.note: The entry stamps: fact id to the monotonic sample at which it entered. A table beside working memory, where [IRET.4.3] keeps the stamp inline as the fact's `assert_ns`; the content is the same.

idris.name: ltim_2_8_6__after
idris.note: WHAT THE ASSERT'S OUTCOME DOES TO THE STAMPS: nothing where it was suppressed ('does not enter and keeps its stamp'); the re-stamp where it changed working memory.

idris.name: ltim_2_8_6__assert_stamps
idris.note: THE ENGINE'S ASSERT at a monotonic sample, on the stamps: the id it would mint is the fresh one, and Rete/FireLoop.idr's `iret_19_1__assert_fact` decides, under the lifecycle, whether it enters.

idris.name: ltim_2_8_6__dwell_gate_rises
idris.note: A `dwell >= d` GATE RISES ONCE: for a fixed stamp, true at one monotonic sample, it is true at every later one, whatever the wall clock does. Uses that the monotonic clock does not decrease and that the stamp stands.

idris.name: ltim_2_8_6__entered_is_stamped
idris.note: AN ASSERT THAT CHANGES WORKING MEMORY STAMPS THE FACT IT MINTED with the sample, for every lifecycle, working memory, value and sample: 'stamp each fact, when it enters working memory, with the monotonic clock's current sample'.

idris.name: ltim_2_8_6__first
idris.note: An entity of kind 0 and key 1, asserted with value 10 at sample 3. A fixture.

idris.name: ltim_2_8_6__gt_of
idris.note: And back.

idris.name: ltim_2_8_6__lte_false
idris.note: A false Boolean order is the strict order the other way.

idris.name: ltim_2_8_6__lte_of
idris.note: And back.

idris.name: ltim_2_8_6__lte_true
idris.note: From the Boolean order to the proof.

idris.name: ltim_2_8_6__pick
idris.note: The row is the one looked for, or it is not: a first-order choice, so a proof can rewrite the comparison and let it reduce.

idris.name: ltim_2_8_6__restamp
idris.note: AFTER AN ASSERT THAT CHANGED WORKING MEMORY: a row for the id it minted, at the sample; the rows of facts no longer live go, and so does any stale row of the minted id. A replaced fact's row goes with it, and the replacement 'enters anew and takes a new stamp'.

idris.name: ltim_2_8_6__second
idris.note: Reasserted unchanged at 5: the assert is suppressed. A fixture.

idris.name: ltim_2_8_6__stamp_of
idris.note: A fact's stamp, by id: `Nothing` for a fact that never entered.

idris.name: ltim_2_8_6__stamp_of_head
idris.note: The row at the head is found.

idris.name: ltim_2_8_6__suppressed_keeps_stamps
idris.note: A SUPPRESSED REASSERTION LEAVES EVERY STAMP AS IT WAS, for every lifecycle, working memory, value and sample: 'does not enter and keeps its stamp'.

idris.name: ltim_2_8_6__third
idris.note: Replaced with value 20 at 8: retract-and-replace mints a new fact. A fixture.

idris.name: ltim_2_8_6__three_asserts
idris.note: THREE ASSERTS, EXECUTED: stamped 3 on entry; still 3 after the suppressed reassertion at 5; after the replacement at 8 the new fact, id 1, is stamped 8 and the old id has no row. The clause's two named cases on one entity.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_4__arrive_timed
idris.note: The arrival's sweep on the net as it stands, then Rete/NetworkTimed.idr's input, so the retractions precede the answer in working memory. LESS than the clause: the stream's record order is not modelled. THE EMPTY CORRELATION IS EXEMPT from the arrival's sweep, as the clause has it: an answer whose `corr` is the empty String supersedes nothing, and the consequence holds for each non-empty correlation.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_4__no_corr_arrival_is_the_input
idris.note: WITH NO KIND CARRYING A `corr` AN ARRIVAL IS THE INPUT, over every event and state.

idris.name: Ltim_2_4_1__timed_state
idris.note: The entry stamps are engine state beside the deadline table and the trackers, not a slot of any fact.

idris.name: lexp_9_5_1__dwell_leaf
idris.note: `dwell` measures from the entry stamp: the stamp read by the fact's id is what the leaf subtracts from the sample. A transcription.

idris.name: ltim_2_4_1__read_at
idris.note: `dwell` measures from the entry stamp, read off the stamp table by the fact's id, and from no slot a schema declares.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_1__dwell_window_reopens
idris.note: The window measures from one entry stamp throughout: no reassertion, one wrapper, two openings of its gate. Executed.

idris.name: ltim_2_5_4__run_if
idris.note: A refused RHS enters no fact and leaves every stamp.

idris.name: ltim_2_8_6__input_timed
idris.note: A data input stamps the fact it mints with the held monotonic sample, through Rete/EntryStamp.idr's assert: a suppressed reassertion keeps its stamp, an entered fact takes the clock, a replace restamps; a retraction stamps nothing.

idris.name: ltim_2_8_6__input_timed_projects
idris.note: A DATA INPUT PROJECTS to Rete/NetworkCooldown.idr's prepared data event: the stamps ride beside the sweep and the apply, for an assert and for a retract.

idris.name: ltim_2_8_6__record_action
idris.note: WHAT ONE RHS ACTION DOES TO THE STAMPS: an emit stamps the fact it mints with the clock, through Rete/EntryStamp.idr's assert under the kind's lifecycle with the fresh id the deadline stamp uses; a suppressed no-op keeps every stamp, a replace restamps; a withdraw stamps nothing. 'Stamp each fact, when it enters working memory', for a fact a firing enters.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__do_action_stamped
idris.note: The stamps follow each action: a mint at the clock, a withdrawal leaving them.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__do_actions_stamped
idris.note: The stamps after every action of a firing.

idris.name: ltac_3_3__explicit_mint_is_stamped
idris.note: 'The engine stamps each fact, when it enters working memory, with the monotonic clock's current sample': the explicit mint enters and takes it.

idris.name: ltac_3_3__stamp_is_fire_at
idris.note: The timer's entry stamp is the sample the parent's firing held; `dwell` measures from it.

idris.name: ltac_3_4__due_stamped
idris.note: The gate reads the candidate's entry stamp and nothing else of it. A fixture.

idris.name: Ltim_2_8_1__sampled_net
idris.note: The entry stamps are engine state beside the deadline table, not a slot of any fact.

idris.name: lexp_9_5_1__dwell_at
idris.note: `dwell` measures from the entry stamp read off the stamp table.

idris.name: lexp_9_5_1__dwell_gate
idris.note: `dwell` reads the monotonic sample and the stamp, no slot.

idris.name: lexp_9_5_1__dwell_gate_rising
idris.note: For a stamp that stands -- a suppressed reassertion keeps it -- the `dwell` gate rises once; only a replacement, which takes a new stamp, starts it again.

idris.name: lexp_9_5_1__dwell_start
idris.note: The `Ping` stamped at 0 in the stamp table. A fixture.

idris.name: ltim_2_7_1__within_at
idris.note: `within` measures from the entry stamp read off the stamp table; a fact that never entered has none and fails.

idris.name: ltim_2_7_1__within_gate
idris.note: `within` reads the monotonic sample and the stamp, 'no slot a schema declares'.

idris.name: ltim_2_8_4__apply_sampled
idris.note: A data input stamps the fact it mints with the held monotonic sample, through Rete/EntryStamp.idr's assert: suppressed keeps, entered stamps, replaced re-stamps.

idris.name: ltim_2_8_6__ticks_keep_stamps
idris.note: A tick enters no fact, so it stamps nothing: a TRANSCRIPTION of the pump's definition, `Refl`.

idris.name: ltim_2_8_3__wall_set_keeps_stamps
idris.note: The entry stamps are engine state a wall step does not reach. A transcription.
